messages:
sam: Quick heads-up the office tea stash got raided and all thats left is chamomile and one rogue box of peppermint. anyone want me to re-stock on my walk?
olivia: please yes 60b everything else is gone. matcha would be a dream.
rex: also can we replace the communal sugar with smaller individual packets? the jar is always sticky.
tara: tiny poll: reply with emoji
- :tea: restock standard teas (black, green)
- :cup_with_straw: matcha powder
- :candy: individual sugar/sweetener packets

sam: leaving in 10 for the corner store. I can grab all three if people want.
rex: :candy: packets please. also grab decaf if they have it.
olivia: :cup_with_straw: matcha please. and oat milk if possible.
tara: :tea: black and green staples for the team.
kitchen-bot: FYI - Facilities requests any food deliveries be left at reception after 5pm this week.
sam: Got it. Ill get: black+green, matcha tin, oat milk, and a box of assorted packets. Back by 4:15.
olivia: Legend. Coffee fairy duties accepted.
tara: thank you! Ill bring a little labeled basket for packets so we dont end up with sticky tables again.
rex: I will label: 'open at own risk' for the peppermint.
sam: Closing thread: restock run planned, basket incoming. Tag me if you want anything extra.
